description: This file defines the PdfRectangle class, a lightweight, immutable representation of a rectangle in a PDF context, including various constructors, properties, and utility methods for geometric computations.

classes.name: PdfRectangle
classes.description: Represents an immutable rectangle in PDF, defined by two diagonal corner points, with additional constructors for different coordinate types and methods for geometric operations.

methods.name: PdfRectangle
methods.description: Multiple constructors for initializing a rectangle with various coordinate types and sources, including points, sizes, rectangles, and PDF array items.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current PdfRectangle instance.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Protected method implementing actual copying logic for the Clone method.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Deprecated boolean property indicating if the rectangle is empty (all zeros). Use 'IsZero' instead.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if all rectangle coordinates are zero.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides the equality check to compare rectangle coordinates.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on rectangle coordinates.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two PdfRectangle instances.

methods.name: operator !=
methods.description: Inequality operator to compare two PdfRectangle instances.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Determines if a point, rectangle, or PdfRectangle is contained within the current rectangle.

methods.name: ToXRect
methods.description: Converts this PdfRectangle to an XRect.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the rectangle object to a PDF writer.
